articles.title: India exports Pinaka rockets to Armenia: Check the guided missile system’s capabilities that even France is interested in
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh flagged off the first batch of guided Pinaka rocket systems destined for Armenia from Nagpur. This significant defence export underscores India's growing capabilities in manufacturing advanced weaponry and its commitment to 'Make in India' for global markets. The deal strengthens strategic defence cooperation between India and Armenia, marking a notable milestone in India's defence exports.

articles.title: Syria tightens grip after Kurds pull back, but Islamic State prisoners escape
articles.summary: Accusations have surfaced against the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) for allegedly freeing militants from Shaddadi prison in Syria, claims which the SDF strongly denies. Concurrently, Syrian government troops are consolidating their control across significant northern and eastern territories. This situation highlights the complex and volatile multi-faction conflict continuing in Syria, impacting regional stability and security dynamics.
